note: Background radii are normalized band geometry and remain invariant; only pixel-sized soft effects scale with output density. The digest also folds in dotSizeClip over 0, 3.8, 12, 50, 200 and 500px at each height -- dot size is the one pixel-sized quantity that moves the OTHER way, divided by the output height rather than multiplied by the 1080p ratio, and digesting the two together is what catches a change that quietly routes it through visualEffectScale.
